scientific_integrity: Explicit proof includes all degree cases, a constructive sharp counterexample, spectral derivation and a separate finite checker; computational tests are not treated as infinite proof; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The contact-persistence theorem is for self-inclusive fixed-confidence asynchronous single-vertex averaging on finite undirected graphs; the quantitative factor applies to initially fully active cycles and is sharp only for a single conditional step. Corresponding results for adaptive confidence, weighted means, pairwise or synchronous updates are unproved.
title: A sharp degree-two boundary for persistent confidence ties and exact cycle dissipation
